ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: MyGUI 3.5.4, the GUI engine (widgets, skins, layouts, fonts)
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The render system independent core of MyGUI 3.5.4. The render systems are the platform modules MyGUI.OpenGLPlatform, MyGUI.OpenGL3Platform, MyGUI.OpenGLESPlatform and MyGUI.OgrePlatform. The header MyGUI_Config.h which the upstream CMake build generates is checked in. TrueType fonts use the freetype module, XML uses the pugixml module and text conversion the utfcpp module. MyGUI is built as C++17.
